source_name: arXiv bulk source TeX mathematical expressions

official_access.access_mode: AWS S3 requester-pays source tar chunks; no page-by-page crawling
official_access.metadata_format: arXiv metadata format with categories and license

scope.original_representation: exact TeX source slice including delimiter or environment
exclusions: macro expansion or semantic reconstruction in the extracted stage

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin the official S3 source-manifest selection and the exact OAI-PMH metadata harvest used for license/category joins. Build a deterministic inventory SHA-256 for the OAI XML pages with build-source-inventory.py, then define source_snapshot from a canonical digest of src_selection_sha256 plus oai_inventory_sha256. Persist every downloaded source chunk's local SHA-256 after verifying the official size and MD5 fields. A wall-clock date alone is insufficient.

license_policy.rule: Most arXiv articles use the default arXiv license, which does not give arXiv the right to grant third-party redistribution. The Atlas may analyze lawfully acquired source locally, but the Internet Archive lake publishes formula occurrence rows only when the exact article/version license is explicitly cleared by the allowlist. If source-version to license-version matching is ambiguous, fail closed. Source packages themselves are never republished by this lane.

adapter.input: official requester-pays S3 source tar chunks plus local OAI-PMH arXiv metadata harvest
adapter.license_default: fail-closed; non-allowlisted, missing, unknown, or version-ambiguous licenses emit no publishable occurrence
